title: Coordinator state for the next session
role: Coordinator: plans, writes prompts for other sessions, reviews their PRs, merges. Does not write feature code itself (small test or docs fixes are fine).
owner_rules: Owner writes Russian, takes part minimally (AGENTS.md 'Owner And Questions'); design questions go to another session or are decided by the agent and reported.
Always tell the owner about open questions: one line each, settled how, or a yes/no question with a recommendation; explain product questions in plain words (what a reader of the site notices).
Coordinator may merge docs and test PRs itself after review and green CI.
Code PRs (behavior or move-only refactors): merge only with the owner's yes.
Tags v0.1.NNN trigger deploy: only on the owner's request. Do not watch the deploy unless asked; a read-only health check after a dependency change is fine.
Prod (ssh ai-news) is read-only; any write needs the owner's yes.
Work in git worktrees from origin/master; no git writes in the main folder. venv1 is editable on the main folder: in a worktree run checks with PYTHONPATH=src ../AI_PARSER/venv1/bin/...
Docs-only PRs skip the full gate (say so in the PR). Merge with gh pr merge --merge.
Independent tasks may run in parallel sessions; give the owner the exact launch line for each. Prompts live untracked in docs/ while active, then go to docs/archive/2026-10/ in a docs PR.
zsh: write ${VAR} before ':' in refspecs ($SHA:refs is read as a modifier).
